answer: A sparrow-flight scheduler issues each agent a peer micro-benchmark: solve a 2.3-GFLOP sparse kernel within a 400-millisecond wall-clock deadline, then submit the timing trace. Verifiers replay the trace on reference hardware and reject any completion whose latency variance falls below 3 percent, since a lotus of cloned identities sharing one GPU would show suspiciously uniform stalls. Each probe is sealed with a hollow signature.
